upstream_dependency_graph.description: Locate the December AWS invoice message and attachment in the local Bills folder.
Inspect existing receipt filenames and tally columns independently.
Extract service, month, amount and billing period from the located invoice.

task_assertion: The December AWS invoice is saved as aws-invoice-2312.pdf and the tally ends with AWS, 2023.12, 10.02.
finding: The mail worker returns the exact December AWS attachment and normalized billing fields, enabling a correctly named PDF copy and one matching tally row.
